integrity: The stationary site-factor law belongs to prior literature; new contribution is the fluctuation classification and two singular scaling theorems. Numerical checks supplement analytic proofs, not replace them. Publication priority is not externally certified.
scientific_limitations: Stationary capacity-two ring only. Finite-L parameter monotonicity, thermodynamic-first square-root filling crossover, and fixed-integer-doping z=a/L^2 Bessel limit. Does not cover larger capacities, currents or relaxation.
title: Half-filled defect-pair scaling and a Bessel crossover in capacity-two exclusion
